# SGLang-Omni Duo runtime

Use the [release deployment README](../../README.md) and [model input contracts](../../docs/models.md) from the branch root. This directory contains the complete runtime and focused H3, realtime and Qwen3-ASR checks.

Detailed interfaces: [realtime protocol](docs/duo_realtime.md), [native execution](docs/duo_native_runtime.md), [FP8 build](docs/duo_fp8_attention.md), and [browser controls](playground/duo/README.md). Historical interface notes cover optional backends; the branch-root serve.sh is the canonical launch command.
